_doc: Reviewed overrides for scripts/title_match.py. aliases: creator names that are one artist, applied in every category and year. merge: title pairs forced into one row within a category, even when the creators disagree. split: pairs kept apart within a category; a side is a title or [title, creator] when the title alone is shared. Titles match by the normalized key, so case, punctuation and edition suffixes do not matter. Run python3 scripts/near_miss.py --check best-of-2024 best-of-2025 best-of-2026 after an edit.
